old_requirement_body_changes.before: From focused search, Tab reaches filter-view toggle, filter menu, then sidebar; from sidebar Tab reaches shown filters or content pane. Down from search reaches content. Sidebar up/down changes label, left/right move sidebar/content, content right/left expand/collapse folders, Shift-up/down extends selection. Browser search/preview outcomes remain owned by browser workflows; tagging/filter accessibility stays unsupported in source.
old_requirement_body_changes.after: From focused search, Tab reaches filter-view toggle, filter menu, then sidebar; from sidebar Tab reaches shown filters or content pane. Down from search reaches content. Sidebar up/down changes label, left/right move sidebar/content, content right/left expand/collapse folders, Shift-up/down extends selection. Browser search/preview outcomes remain owned by browser workflows; tagging/filter accessibility stays unsupported in source. Browser Workflows004 owns Ctrl+F/Cmd+F search focus with All selection. Browser Content046 owns an eligible selected item preview request via right arrow even while Preview is off; Browser Workflows009 owns generic preview sound. These linked predicates are not duplicated or expanded into all-focus/search/audio behavior here.

old_requirement_body_changes.before: Envelope insert marker moves horizontally on grid and shows value at location. old_requirement_body_changes.after: Envelope insert marker moves horizontally on grid and shows value at location. Enter creates or selects a breakpoint at the marker; horizontal arrows move the pending point; Enter confirms. Alt/Option-left/right jumps previous/next breakpoint. Automation interpolation remains with its canonical owner. The same documented operations have supported track Arrangement automation-lane and clip Envelope Editor contexts where actually available; no every-area/every-envelope cross-product is promised. Alt-click on Windows/Option-click on Mac can move the insert marker to an existing breakpoint and select it. Exact coordinates and parameter-value math remain with automation owners.
